why: The author, 2026-10-01: rotate the models — at about 20 % of the time at random — so that we can learn which model to use where. Haiku and Sonnet through claude -p are first party (decision 011); a model outside the pool is never chosen.

retire when: every contract in use has min_labels labelled rows from each model in the pool, and the exploit choice has not changed over 20 runs
